note: tactix 8 AMOLED (47 mm and 51 mm share one Connect IQ device entry). No LayerTime code runs on it yet, so nothing is verified and every effective value is the DeviceCapabilities default. target is the design intent. It is never read by the application. A field's effective value changes only when its status becomes verified on the watch.

vibration.evidence: https://www.garmin.com.sg/products/outdoor/tactix-8-amoled/ (Alerts & alarms, vibration only). Connect IQ access unverified.

gps.evidence: Watch has GNSS; Connect IQ Position access to be proven on the watch

compass.evidence: https://www.garmin.com.sg/products/outdoor/tactix-8-amoled/ (Sensors: Compass). Connect IQ heading access unverified.

nativeMaps.evidence: LT-ARCH-001 section 8.1: Toybox.WatchUi.MapView supports tactix 8. Physical test is Phase 6.

localWifiMonitor.evidence: LT-ARCH-001 section 4.1: Garmin is not responsible for raw 802.11 capture

localBleMonitor.evidence: LT-ARCH-001 section 4.1: RF detection belongs to the C5

externalRecon.evidence: LayerTime Link over BLE to the C5. Proven or disproven in Phase 1.

meshUi.evidence: LT-ARCH-001 section 4.4: Garmin is the field mesh UI

localMeshtasticRadio.evidence: LT-ARCH-001 section 4.4: mesh reaches Garmin through Android

androidBridge.evidence: LT-ARCH-001 section 4.3. Proven or disproven in Phase 7.
